Use-case detail / requirements:
- Primary workload: chat-based merchant support + realtime fraud scoring via embeddings + nightly batch reconciliation using reranking.
- Latency targets: 50-150ms p50 for chat, 90ms p50 for reranking in critical paths. Throughput: peak 600 QPS during settlement windows.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for residency/compliance guarantees.
- Model preferences: customer prefers open models (Llama variants / open weights) with ability to pin versions, plus ability to run quantized on dedicated GPUs.

Security / legal blockers that killed deal:
- Must have EU-only physical region + no telemetry egress outside EU (explicit contractual clause).
- KMS keys must be customer-managed and resident in EU HSM.
- SOC2/ISO evidence required; Security wanted on-site audit after proof-of-concept.

- Product ask: feasibility doc for EU-only region + customer-managed HSM to be drafted with infra by 2026-05.

- Champion went dark after vendor selection; no internal replacement identified.

Attachments / artifacts: pricing deck (/drive/pricing/decks/trustpay_eu_rfp_v2.pdf), security FAQ link (see drive link), legal thread (thread-PRIORITY-trustpay-legal-2026-02).
